New pics start at page 1226.
Set no. 239 has an incorrect thumbnail, this is how it was published by the artist.

Contents:
001 : meta
003 : legacy Fanbox posts (stuff that used to be on Fanbox, but never on Fantia; possibly incomplete)
063 : current exclusive artworks (using Fantia numbering even when the Fanbox data is used)

Completeness:
- This includes all Fantia media except for a few sketches. There were older Fanbox posts that had no corresponding Fantia ones (and that are now deleted) - it's hard to tell if this part is complete or not. Please share if you have something missing from here.
- For most files the first 3-digit number is the set ID according to the Fantia numbering scheme (note that Fanbox uses a different one). Also, set №18 has an uncensored version, but I have no idea if it's a legit one or something fanmade.
- Note that set no. 163 does not seem to exist.
- Set no. 239 has an incorrect thumbnail, this is how it was published by the artist.
